description: Continued use of site for storage and distribution (Use Class B8) including retention of existing structures (retrospective) and associated development.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [H18623-100, H18623-101, H18623-03 Rev B, H18623-02 Rev B, H18623-01 Rev D, H18623-04 Rev B, H18623-104 Rev A, H18623-103 Rev B, H18623-102 Rev B, Energy Statement & Sustainable Development Report, Delivery and servicing plan, Operational Waste Statement. Received: 09/03/2026].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for the specify use B8 (storage and distribution) and for no other purpose of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), nor in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.

Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.
Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy.
Reason: In order to ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
Condition : 5 - The use of the premises shall only be permitted during the hours of 07:00 to 19:00 Mondays to Fridays, 07:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays nor at any time on Sundays and Public/Bank Holidays. 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding noise sensitive premises is not adversely affected by noise from activities or people at the site. 
Condition : 6 - During use of the workshop facility the roller shutter door shall remain closed at all times, other than during loading/unloading of vehicles or when transferring goods to and from the workshop.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding noise sensitive premises is not adversely affected by noise during use of the workshop facility.
Condition : 7 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than four bicycles) for the employees of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed in the location shown on drawing H18623-01 Rev D. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance( or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Delivery & Servicing Plan hereby approved shall be fully implemented and maintained for the lifetime of the development. 

Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives and road safety.
Condition : 9 - All refuse and recycling bins, delivery cages, trolleys or any other items linked to deliveries and collection in association with the approved development are to be stored within the premises at all times.

Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway
